2609.29775.title: Prefilling the Reasoning Channel: Output-Prefix Attacks on Reasoning LLMs
2609.29775.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) consume and produce a single sequence of text; hence, if text can be added to the beginning of the LLM's response, i.e., an output prefix, then all subsequent tokens will be conditioned on it. This output-prefix attack technique is a cheap black-box prompt injection. Prior work has shown this type of attack can reliably jailbreak non-reasoning models. Most reasoning models add an intermediate scratchpad reasoning step before the assistant's final response. The ability to edit this reasoning channel is exposed by some APIs and attack vectors can be leveraged for reasoning injection attacks. We present the first systematic, controlled study that isolates the scratchpad reasoning channel as an output-prefix attack vector, and the first to compare reasoning-only, output-prefix-only and reasoning-plus-output-prefix attacks across both exposed- and hidden-reasoning models. Using a factorial design of 3 prefix types $\times$ 2 reasoning injections over $1{,}800$ test cases drawn from AdvBench, we attack three 2026-era frontier models Gemini 3 Flash Preview, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and Claude Haiku 4.5. We find that injecting malicious reasoning alone is essentially inert ($\approx0\%$ attack success), but injecting the same reasoning together with a trivial output prefix raises the attack success rate to as high as $99\%$ for some models. For this type of attack we find that contextual prefixes work better than static prefixes; and that susceptibility is dependent on the model.
2609.29775.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）消耗並產生單一的文本序列；因此，如果可以將文本添加到LLM回應的開頭，即輸出前綴，那麼所有後續的標記將基於此進行條件化。這種輸出前綴攻擊技術是一種廉價的黑箱提示注入。先前的研究顯示這種類型的攻擊可以可靠地破解非推理模型。大多數推理模型在助手的最終回應之前會添加一個中間的草稿推理步驟。某些API暴露了編輯這個推理通道的能力，攻擊向量可以被利用來進行推理注入攻擊。我們提出了第一個系統性、受控的研究，將草稿推理通道孤立為一種輸出前綴攻擊向量，並且是第一個比較僅推理、僅輸出前綴和推理加輸出前綴攻擊的研究，涵蓋了暴露和隱藏推理模型。使用 $1{,}800$ 個來自 AdvBench 的測試案例，進行了 3 種前綴類型 $\times$ 2 種推理注入的因子設計，我們攻擊了三個 2026 年的前沿模型：Gemini 3 Flash Preview、DeepSeek V4 Flash 和 Claude Haiku 4.5。我們發現僅注入惡意推理基本上是無效的（攻擊成功率約為 $0\%$），但將相同的推理與微不足道的輸出前綴一起注入，則某些模型的攻擊成功率可高達 $99\%$。對於這種類型的攻擊，我們發現上下文前綴的效果優於靜態前綴；而且易受攻擊性取決於模型。
